phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, around 3 minutes, with both sides having heavy economy and technology investment, moderate production, and no clear army composition yet.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see more of the opponent's army composition or if you detect early pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize tech and economy, keep production moderate, expand safely, and prepare for ground transition.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology, increase production, and strengthen ground army while maintaining a defensive posture and expanding.
phase_policies.title: Tech-Economy Foundation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to tech without maintaining a defensive posture or scouting for early pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-mid game, around 4-6 minutes, with both sides transitioning to a ground-oriented army. Opponent shows Marines, and you have Stalkers and Sentries.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices (e.g., Medivacs, Marauders) or if you face early pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground forces, boost production, maintain economy/tech, expand, and gain vision with Observers.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army, increase production, maintain economy and tech lead, keep expanding, and add Observers for vision.
phase_policies.title: Ground Transition with Vision
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect air defense or overextend without scouting; avoid assuming enemy build without scouting.

phase_policies.applies_when: Mid-game, around 9 minutes, with both sides having heavy production and tech. Opponent shows a ground army with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, and Medivacs. You have Colossus, Stalkers, Sentries, and Warp Prism.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices (e.g., Siege Tanks, Banshees) or if you face a large push.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Build a powerful ground army with tech, keep production and economy strong, and prepare for spell damage options.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army, increase production, maintain economy and tech, and consider adding more Colossus or transitioning to High Templar for spell damage.
phase_policies.title: Tech Army Assembly
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect upgrades or positioning while teching; avoid being caught out of position.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, around 10-12 minutes, with both sides having heavy production and tech. Opponent shows a ground army with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, and Medivacs. You have Colossus, Zealots, Stalkers, and Sentries.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices (e.g., Battlecruisers, Ravens) or if you face a large push.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Consolidate ground forces, keep production and economy high, and adapt with spellcasters or mixed composition.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army, increase production, maintain economy and tech, and consider adding High Templar for Storm or transitioning to a more mixed composition if needed.
phase_policies.title: Consolidation and Adaptation
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect upgrades or positioning; avoid being caught out of position against a timing attack.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
